name: Arnold T. Ocampo Jr.
title: Data Analyst | SQL & Data Pipelines
summary: Data professional with over 10 years of experience in analytics, reporting automation, and business intelligence. Experienced in bringing data from multiple sources together, cleaning and transforming it, and preparing reliable datasets for reporting and analysis. Building on this foundation to transition into data engineering, with a focus on how data moves between systems and stays accurate and usable along the way.

projects.name: FlipTop: From API to Analysis
projects.description: Collects FlipTop video metadata through the YouTube Data API and saves reusable CSV and JSON datasets. Cleans and reshapes the data with pandas, then explores battle and emcee trends in a Jupyter notebook.

projects.name: Snowflake COVID-19 ETL
projects.description: A learning ETL project that loads COVID-19 CSV data into Snowflake and moves it through raw, cleaned, and monthly-summary layers. Includes SQL data-quality checks, stored procedures, and a daily task definition.

projects.name: SQL Server Data Warehouse
projects.description: A practice warehouse integrating sample CRM and ERP CSV data in SQL Server. Uses bulk loads and stored procedures to clean and standardize records, then exposes customer and product dimensions and sales facts for analysis.
